page: Amazon Web Services g5.2xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro System, tailored for graphics rendering and machine learning inference. It provides an NVIDIA A10G GPU based on the Ampere architecture with 22 GB of dedicated GDDR6 VRAM. The host system is powered by an AMD EPYC 7R32 processor delivering 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores at 3.3 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. System memory comprises 32 GB of DDR4 running at 3 GHz, maintaining a 4:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. Local scratch storage includes a bundled 450 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

Benchmark results highlight strong specialization in machine learning inference relative to general compute. With its NVIDIA A10G GPU, the instance achieves top-tier results in language model execution, yielding 9285.03 prompt tokens per second and 419.11 generation tokens per second on 135M parameter models, alongside 2885.13 prompt tokens per second and 93.08 generation tokens per second on 7B models. In contrast, CPU-only raw compute demonstrates modest capability: stress-ng single-core (767.88) places in the bottom 10 percent and multi-core (3072.15) ranks in the bottom 25 percent. General host processing benchmarks, such as Geekbench (1341 single-core, 5187 multi-core) and PassMark CPU (10578.14), settle firmly in the mid-range bracket.

Uncached memory bandwidth represents a measurable tradeoff, with large-block sequential read speeds of 36.14 GB/sec and write speeds of 22.56 GB/sec falling in the lower quartile. However, the presence of direct-attached NVMe storage ensures low-latency operations for caching and fast model weights loading. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile avoids the expense of larger multi-GPU enterprise systems while supplying sufficient VRAM for mid-sized deep learning models. Workloads that align closely with this configuration include real-time LLM inference, remote graphics rendering, video processing pipelines, and GPU-accelerated web serving applications.
description: Amazon Web Services g5.2xlarge is an accelerated computing instance designed for machine learning inference and graphics-intensive tasks. Driven by the Nitro System, the instance couples an NVIDIA Ampere A10G GPU featuring 22 GB of VRAM with an 8-vCPU AMD EPYC 7R32 processor clocked at 3.3 GHz. Memory is provisioned at 32 GB of DDR4, paired with a bundled 450 GB NVMe SSD for fast local storage and 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. While synthetic CPU stress tests fall into lower performance quartiles, real-world deep learning metrics show top-tier inference speeds for sub-10B parameter models. Its balanced host memory and local NVMe drive make it a practical platform for model serving, video transcoding, and interactive graphics workloads without requiring multi-GPU system overhead.
